data.content: Corrected ownership after implementation review: knots-2af8 supplies SyncService::install_v2_checkpoint and drain_v2_quarantine. CheckpointInput requires ValidatedProtection plus exact protected control/canonical bytes and source facts; retained replay executes inside the replacement transaction. Plain Git metadata never self-attests. The dependent provider-adapter Knot must fetch live GitHub/Diffinite facts and bytes, construct ValidatedProtection, and invoke this boundary.
